raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 4
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner switched criteria from “earliest widely recognized release date” to “primary-country official release date” for Niyoti (using 24 June 2016 instead of the earlier 10 June 2016 India release), leading to the wrong conclusion that Angali Pangali (17 June 2016) was earlier. Using the earliest release dates, Niyoti (10 June 2016) came out earlier.
